patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Facebook beside the first under its own package name and app name, for a phone where Facebook came preinstalled and a patched one won't install over it. Hushfacebook settings open in the copy the same way. It isn't selected by default because push notifications may not reach the copy, and you only need it for a second Facebook. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sheet options
patches_modified.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, close an open reply thread with a Hide replies button, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide the comments under feed posts, hide the thumbs-down on comments or turn it into a Block button, put Block on reaction lists, hide Like on comments, hide Reply on comments, hide badges like Top fan on comments, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, show only the comments a search matches, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, keep every reaction beside a comment's count, hide the emoji row over the comment box, hide the line over the comment box, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Default comment order
patches_modified.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest, All comments or Oldest, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Disable Audience Network
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Don't save search history
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops sending Facebook the reels and videos you've watched, where you stopped in a video and how long you watched it, so they stay out of Videos you've watched in your activity log and Facebook learns less about what you watch. Videos you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Double tap to skip
patches_modified.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. Hide the skip seconds there, also off, keeps the +5s or -10s off the screen while the skip still works.

patches_modified.name: Download any photo
patches_modified.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. A long press on a comment with a photo or GIF in it offers Save photo or Save GIF. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. The More menu also gets Copy caption, which copies the reel's whole caption. On by default. Turn either off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed, in Watch and in the photo and video viewer, so you can save them to watch later. A post with several videos gets Save all videos. A video comment gets Save video when you long-press it. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. A video comment gets Save video when you long-press it. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Fold long text
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many lines a long post or comment shows before See more, from 1 to 20, so you can fold sooner or read more before tapping. Starts at Facebook's choice. Pick the lines for posts in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, and for comments under Comments and writing. A video's caption follows the count for posts. While Show full post text is on, posts still show whole.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you pick how many lines a long post or comment shows before See more, from 1 to 20, so you can fold sooner or read more before tapping. Starts at Facebook's choice. Pick the lines for posts in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, and for comments under Comments and writing. While Show full post text is on, posts still show whole.

patches_modified.name: Following feed on Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Force dark mode
patches_modified.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Frame step
patches_modified.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: For phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Facebook asks microG-RE for its push notifications, and microG-RE gets the signature of Meta's own Facebook for the Google services that check one. Install microG-RE first. It isn't selected by default because Facebook then stops asking Google Play services, so on a phone without microG-RE push notifications stop and Google shows a notice asking you to get Play services. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. Switches there, off by default, also hide the Meta AI shortcut, the Your shortcuts row, the Create Facebook Page row or the whole Help and support section and keep Settings and privacy open, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches_modified.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tray
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches_modified.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels and the shop banner on a profile you open from one, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches_modified.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide post prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Eight more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide the Subscribe link on posts, Hide the Join button on posts, Hide the X on posts, Hide counts on posts, Hide the reaction preview on posts, Hide friends' reactions on photos and videos and Hide who reacted under posts, start off.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Six more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide the Subscribe link on posts, Hide the Join button on posts, Hide the X on posts, Hide counts on posts and Hide the reaction preview on posts, start off.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts by words
patches_modified.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts, every post a Page wrote, or posts in languages you don't read can go too. Your words and link posts also work on profiles, Pages and in groups. On the Reels tab they go by each reel's caption, and so do other languages. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the note bubble on profile pictures, the Drop a thought prompt on your own profile included. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Switches that take the profile picture off the top of posts and off comments, so the name starts where the picture was. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt and the survey between reels asking how well a video matches your interests, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide seen posts
patches_modified.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7, 30 or 90 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. It also reads rules typed into Marketplace search: "word" keeps titles with the word, -word hides titles with it and in:place keeps listings in that place, and an Adv. Filters button writes them for you. The search rules and the button are off until you turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches_modified.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches_modified.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide story rings
patches_modified.description: Switches that take the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures at the top of posts, next to comments and on profiles, one for each. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches_modified.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories, where more switches, all off at first, also hide the Create story tile, the Pages you follow and the stories you've already watched, keep only the ones you've watched, or move the ones you've watched to the end.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation.

patches_modified.name: Hide tabs
patches_modified.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use, and puts the ones left in the order you want. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Pick the tabs and their order in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches_modified.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches_modified.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch, and a third keeps the plain 2x pill without Facebook's "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Home header text
patches_modified.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, the title at the top of another tab, or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon, Icon style can make the icon Hushfacebook's logo, white on black or black on white, and Notification icon puts Hushfacebook's H on notifications. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_modified.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches_modified.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. It can also keep a long watch of a video you open from turning the feed's sound on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: A video you started with a tap keeps its sound when you leave Facebook, with Facebook's own notification to pause it. A headphones button in the picture-in-picture window does the same for the video in it. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Keep post dates
patches_modified.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Live videos that have ended get Playback speed in their gear menu too, also on by default. Another switch, off to start, puts Playback speed from 0.5x to 3x in a feed or Watch video's three-dot menu. All of it is in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Local profile counts
patches_modified.description: Shows friends, followers and following counts you type yourself on your own profile, on this phone only. Other profiles and Facebook's real numbers aren't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Longer music on photo stories
patches_modified.description: A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Newest reels first
patches_modified.description: Plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first in the Reels tab, instead of Facebook's own pick. It can't fetch newer reels. A second switch lists a profile's Reels tab with its most viewed reels first. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates. Open chats in Messenger, another switch that starts off, opens chats in Messenger instead of inside Facebook, the Message button on a profile included.

patches_modified.name: Open comments at full height
patches_modified.description: Opens the comment sheet at full or half height instead of part way up. Full height fills the screen on posts, videos, reels and stories. Half height covers half the screen, and the reel or video keeps playing above it. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. Other switches pause a reel while its comments are open, let a tap on the reel above a half-open sheet play or pause it, and put a magnifier at the top of the comments that searches them for your words. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches_modified.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. It also lets a long press on a post's text open that text to select part of it, a switch in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Two more switches there make holding a post's photo, or its video, open its reactions or give one reaction you pick.

patches_modified.name: Open in Facebook from the share menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Open in Facebook to Android's share menu. Share a Facebook link or page to it from Messenger's browser or any other app, and it opens here instead of in that app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it. A Page's Events link opens on that Page's Events tab instead of Home, whichever way the switches are set.

patches_modified.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Photo carousel
patches_modified.description: Shows a post's photos and videos in a row you swipe through, one at a time with a 4/10 count and dots, instead of a grid. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Pinch to zoom
patches_modified.description: Pinch a story, a video in your feed, or a photo on someone's profile or in Photo carousel to zoom in, like you can on other photos in the feed. It goes back when you let go, unless you turn on Stay zoomed under it, which keeps the zoom until you tap or press Back. Keep videos playing while zoomed, another switch under it, lets a video play on while you zoom, stories included, and with Stay zoomed you press and hold to pause it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Post action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts, and a Download button on posts with a video or photos that saves them the way the post's menu does. It can also take Like, Comment, Share or Send out of that row. Each has its own switch, and they all start off. Find them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Post menu items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide rows you never use from the three-dot menu of posts and reels, such as Interested, Not interested or Cast, so you can't tap them by accident. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Remove the gap above Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Takes out the empty band some phones show between the status bar and a Marketplace listing's close and share buttons, like Pixels on Android 17. Phones without the gap look the same as before. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it, and opens Instagram and Threads links in a patched Instagram or Threads. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. It also lets Take breaks count reels for its Also after 20 reels switch.

patches_modified.name: Round stories tray
patches_modified.description: Draws the stories row on Home as round pictures at a size you pick, like Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing.

patches_modified.name: Saved button in search
patches_modified.description: Adds a Saved button at the end of the search bar, so your saved posts and videos are one tap away. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Search date range
patches_modified.description: Adds a from and to date picker to the Date posted filter in post search, in place of the list of years, so you can narrow results to a few days or a stretch of months. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Search posts tab
patches_modified.description: Puts the Posts chip back in the row over search results, after Reels, so you can see only posts for what you searched. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: See who shared
patches_modified.description: Adds See who shared to a post's menu, which opens Facebook's list of the people who shared it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches_modified.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Show full post text
patches_modified.description: Shows all of a post's text in the feed, and a reel's caption, so you don't have to tap See more. A tap on the text folds it back. Starts off. Turn posts on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, and reel captions under Reels and Watch, where an open or folded caption can also sit on a dark box like subtitles. The names on reels and stories can get the same box.

patches_modified.name: Skip location prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook from showing its page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue that comes up after you sign in. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Skip silent parts
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Story viewer taps
patches_modified.description: A tap in the middle of a story shows a play and pause button, like Reels, and a second switch makes stories change only on a double tap, so a single tap pauses or plays instead. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. `Tab bar position` can also put it at the top, as older Facebook had it, or leave it where Facebook puts it. `Tab bar while scrolling` lets it slide away as you scroll or keeps it on screen, and another switch keeps the top bar on screen. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top, and another keeps the Reels tab's bars light in light mode, like the other tabs. One hides the tab bar on the Reels tab alone, so the reel gets the whole screen. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Pick it in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook. The see-through, status bar and Reels tab switches sit under Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Tap shows the controls
patches_modified.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. A separate switch adds a play/pause button to feed videos. The switches start off in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Translate posts
patches_modified.description: Translates posts in another language through Google Translate, from a Translate line under the post or by themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. A second switch fixes pale, washed-out reels on phones that show them that way. Its switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches_modified.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches_modified.description: Shows posts, comments and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a reel, a video or a photo in the feed from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays, pauses or opens the photo, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches_modified.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches_modified.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, where you can also pick an emoji font file, then restart Facebook.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Use the system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Queue likes filter
patches_added.description: Adds an option to remove songs with few likes from auto-generated mixes and radio, using the like counts of Return YouTube Dislike. Playlists and albums are left unchanged.

patches_added.name: Android Auto parked app mode
patches_added.description: Declares YouTube a parked video app, so Android Auto (early access only) and DriveDeck (available now) list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.

patches_added.name: Open post images in fullscreen
patches_added.description: Adds an option to open the images of posts in fullscreen with one tap, instead of the posts feed.

patches_added.name: Ungroup notifications
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show every video of the notifications that YouTube groups by channel as its own notification.

patches_modified.name: AI channel filter
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide videos from channels flagged as AI-generated by the AiSList community list and to report AI channels from the video menu.

patches_modified.name: Add to queue
patches_modified.description: Adds a video queue to the feed flyout menu, using either the Morphe queue or a native queue that uses YouTube's playlist interface.

patches_modified.name: Ambient mode
patches_modified.description: Adds Enhanced Ambient mode and options to force Ambient mode on, bypass its power saving restrictions, and disable it entirely or in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: App refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches_modified.name: Ask flyout menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a video menu entry that opens Ask for the video and summarizes the video. This patch works with YouTube 21.16.256 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Autoplay control
patches_modified.description: Adds a player button and a rule for the next video: playlists and queues go on, a Mix stops after a number of videos, a suggested video never plays.

patches_modified.name: Bypass image region restrictions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.

patches_modified.name: Bypass link redirects
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly.

patches_modified.name: Captions
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable captions from being automatically enabled, select a preferred and a secondary caption language, add more auto-translate languages, and show captions in stable blocks and in picture-in-picture. Stable blocks and bilingual captions work with YouTube 21.15 and newer, on Android 10 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Change form factor
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device.

patches_modified.name: Change header
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

patches_modified.name: Change picture-in-picture actions
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the buttons shown in picture-in-picture mode.

patches_modified.name: Change start page
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches_modified.name: Channel search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube.

patches_modified.name: Channel whitelist
patches_modified.description: Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds.

patches_modified.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches_modified.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches_modified.name: Copy text

patches_modified.name: Copy video link

patches_modified.name: Custom branding

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the app with the device system font or a custom TTF or OTF font file instead of YouTube Sans.

patches_modified.name: Custom player overlay opacity
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the opacity of the video player background when player controls are visible.

patches_modified.name: DeArrow
patches_modified.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API, or replace video thumbnails with image captures from the video.

patches_modified.name: Disable DRC audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches_modified.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches_modified.name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop feeds from refreshing automatically after they become outdated.

patches_modified.name: Disable continue watching prompt
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to keep autoplay going instead of pausing with a "Continue watching" prompt after a period of inactivity, or to always show the autoplay countdown at the end of the video.

patches_modified.name: Disable double tap actions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable player double tap gestures.

patches_modified.name: Disable fullscreen gestures
patches_modified.description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom.

patches_modified.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions.

patches_modified.name: Disable layout updates
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI.

patches_modified.name: Disable player popup panels
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically.

patches_modified.name: Disable playlist autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video.

patches_modified.name: Disable rolling number animations
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable rolling number animations of video view count, user likes, and upload time.

patches_modified.name: Disable scrolling speed limit
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled.

patches_modified.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network.

patches_modified.name: Disable video codecs
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 or AV1 codecs.

patches_modified.name: Double tap to seek
patches_modified.description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu.

patches_modified.name: Download post images
patches_modified.description: Adds a button and a menu item to download the images and GIFs of posts.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button, adds an option to download videos in-app, and exports saved videos to the device.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Exit fullscreen mode
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end.

patches_modified.name: Feed card layout
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show or hide the card layout of feed videos, which YouTube sends as an A/B test.

patches_modified.name: Feed video actions
patches_modified.description: Adds a Watch later button to video thumbnails in feeds, and opens the video menu by tapping and holding anywhere on a video.

patches_modified.name: Feed view count
patches_modified.description: Adds the view count to the bottom left of the thumbnails of feed videos.

patches_modified.name: Force animations
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always turn on or off the app animations that YouTube can turn off, such as the player transitions.

patches_modified.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen playlist panel
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the playlist panel over the fullscreen player on tablets, instead of exiting fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches_modified.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide info cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the Cast button, the player Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Hide related video overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Hide related videos
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide status bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.

patches_modified.name: Hide timestamp
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches_modified.name: Loop count
patches_modified.description: Adds a player settings menu item to choose how many times the app loops a video, before it plays the next video. In a playlist, the loop count is remembered for each video.

patches_modified.name: Loop video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.208 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches_modified.name: Mute button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Niconico comments
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show live chat and chat replay as comments that scroll across the video.

patches_modified.name: On-the-go player
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to open a panel with large playback controls from the On-the-go item of the video player menu. While the panel is open, the lock screen media controls have seek buttons.

patches_modified.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches_modified.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback buffer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Player icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: Playlist button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a button in the video player that opens the playlist panel.

patches_modified.name: Playlist improvements
patches_modified.description: Adds options to widen playlist drag handles, reorder videos by long press, and hide removal confirmations.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike, and the like count and like ratio on the thumbnails of feed videos.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player, and adds a setting to redirect Watch later saves to a playlist of your choice.

patches_modified.name: Search comments
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to the comments to show only the loaded comments that contain the searched words.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, customizing the seekbar thumb with an image or GIF, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Series tracking
patches_modified.description: Adds a series library to History with local progress and episode continuation. This patch works with YouTube 21.02 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Skip live Shorts

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: Snackbar

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme

patches_modified.name: Translate live chat

patches_modified.description: Adds a menu item to translate the text of posts.

patches_modified.name: Video quality

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide feed posts with a flair of a community.

patches_added.name: Keyword filters
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide feed posts with a title or text that matches a regular expression.

patches_added.name: Bardo recently added

patches_added.name: Bardo watchlist filter

patches_added.name: Hide Video Store

Extends the daemon launcher script (raw resource 'up') with a validated gate poker that runs on every daemon start; unknown daemon layouts fail safe. Requires root (the daemon itself runs as root).

patches_added.name: Unlock optional features

patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that opens Kick's chat as a guest, the way Kick opens it when you're signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in: the chat page gets neither your sign-in token nor your account's name and ID, so its own connection to Kick's chat isn't yours. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on, and messages that mention you aren't highlighted. Kick can still tell that you are watching: the player's playback request (postPlayerTelemetry) and the app's own live connection still identify you. Checked signed out only; whether Kick then leaves you off a channel's chatter list needs an account to see. The switch applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Not selected by default; once included, its switch starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Matching happens on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere. Mentions need a signed-in account; the word and user lists start empty. A hidden message can show for a moment before it disappears. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat text size
patches_modified.description: Sets the chat text size, from 12 to 24 pixels, and can pack chat messages closer together (compact chat). Kick's own chat settings have a text size for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while set, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the text, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts at Kick's size with compact chat off. Choose another in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time next to each chat message, in 24-hour (13:05) or 12-hour (1:05) format as on Twitch. Kick's own chat settings can show times for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Insider (start-up, events and queued uploads), Datadog (its start-up, so its view, action, log and trace calls go nowhere), Mux and Datazoom player analytics, and Google PAL nonce requests. Kick's own API requests still run, including the playback request that returns the stream. A second switch, Block device fingerprinting, stops FingerprintJS Pro, which Kick uses to identify this device when you sign up, for age checks and when a signed-in session starts; it starts off because sign-up and age checks can fail while it is on. Disable analytics is on by default; turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy and restart Kick. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams. patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Fill screen

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights

Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature-content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips Kick's "18+ Mature Content Warning" on mature streams when you're signed out, as if you had tapped "I am 18+". Signed in, Kick goes by your account's own age and this changes nothing; age checks Kick runs where the law requires them aren't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator. Starts off. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Lurk in account menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Lurk row to Kick's account menu (tap your profile picture while signed in), which opens Lurk settings. Pause Lurk leaves it on. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Advanced. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched live ads
patches_modified.description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. While Kick's player reports an ad break stitched into a live stream, mutes the player and covers the video with black and a small "Ad break", then restores both when the break's time is up, it ends, or another stream loads. The ad still plays for its full length and can't be skipped; this only silences and hides it. It acts on the ad signals Kick's player can get: an SCTE-35 ad break in the stream itself, or an ad of a MediaTailor session, which Kick only starts with Disable analytics off. None arrived in signed-out sessions, so this was checked only with made-up ad signals fed to Kick's own player code. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. patches_modified.name: Normal latency

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Lurk turns this view on inside the chat page on your phone; the chat address the app sends to Kick stays as Kick builds it, so Kick's server sees no change. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete does nothing unless you moderate the channel. Needs an Android System WebView that can run a script before the page's own (any current one). A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows viewer and follower counts in full, such as 306,112 followers instead of 306.1K. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats

The numbers come from the player on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere, and the panel never takes a tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that shows the 7TV badge each chatter chose next to their name in chat. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. It keeps a connection to 7TV's event service (events.7tv.io) while a channel's chat is open, which tells 7TV the channel (its owner's Kick user ID), as the 7TV emotes switch does, and nothing about you or the chatters you see; 7TV sends the badges of that channel's chatters and their images come from cdn.7tv.app. FrankerFaceZ, Chatterino and pronouns.alejo.io only know Twitch accounts, so Kick has no switches for them.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, asks again every 5 minutes while the chat is open, keeps a websocket to events.7tv.io open for the channel's emote sets and loads images from cdn.7tv.app, so 7TV can see which channels you watch and for how long. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialogs black; dividers and buttons keep their grey. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that opens a live stream's chat as a guest, the way Rumble opens it when you're signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in: the chat connection is made without your session cookie, so Rumble's chat server doesn't list you among the chat's users. Sending chat messages and Rants is disabled while it's on, moderator tools are missing from the chat, and messages that mention you may not be highlighted. Rumble can still tell that you are watching: the video page's other requests, such as the video's details and the chat's emote list, are still made as you. Applies to chats opened afterwards. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Background audio by default
patches_modified.description: Makes Settings > Playback > Background Play default to Sound only: leaving the app keeps the sound playing instead of opening a picture-in-picture window. A choice made in Rumble's settings still wins. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block ads
patches_modified.description: Removes video ads (before and during videos and live streams), the ads in feeds and under videos and Home's ad sections, signed in or not. The app never requests them, so it never sends the ad server your advertising ID. Boosted (paid) videos are left out of Home, related videos, search and categories, and no ad or Boosted video impressions or clicks are reported.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
